verses.en: Ta Sin Mim
These are the verses of the Scripture that makes things clear:
[Prophet], are you going to worry yourself to death because they will not believe?
verses.ar: لَعَلَّكَ بَـٰخِعٌ نَّفْسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُوا۟ مُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: If We had wished, We could have sent them down a sign from heaven, at which their necks would stay bowed in utter humility.
verses.ar: إِن نَّشَأْ نُنَزِّلْ عَلَيْهِم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ ءَايَةً فَظَلَّتْ أَعْنَـٰقُهُمْ لَهَا خَـٰضِعِينَ

verses.en: Whenever they are brought a new revelation from the Lord of Mercy, they turn away:
verses.ar: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن ذِكْرٍ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ مُحْدَثٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ عَنْهُ مُعْرِضِينَ

verses.en: they deny it, but the truth of what they scorned will soon hit them.
verses.ar: فَقَدْ كَذَّبُوا۟ فَسَيَأْتِيهِمْ أَنۢبَـٰٓؤُا۟ مَا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ

verses.en: Do they not see the earth, and what noble kinds of thing We grow in it?
verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَرَوْا۟ إِلَى ٱلْأَرْضِ كَمْ أَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍ كَرِيمٍ

verses.en: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
Your Lord called to Moses: ‘Go to those wrongdoers,
verses.ar: وَإِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبُّكَ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱئْتِ ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ

verses.en: the people of Pharaoh. Will they not take heed?’
Moses said, ‘My Lord, I fear they will call me a liar,
verses.ar: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُكَذِّبُونِ

verses.en: and I will feel stressed and tongue-tied, so send Aaron too;
verses.ar: وَيَضِيقُ صَدْرِى وَلَا يَنطَلِقُ لِسَانِى فَأَرْسِلْ إِلَىٰ هَـٰرُونَ

verses.en: besides, they have a chargeagainst me, and I fear they may kill me.’
verses.ar: وَلَهُمْ عَلَىَّ ذَنۢبٌ فَأَخَافُ أَن يَقْتُلُونِ

verses.en: God said, ‘No [they will not]. Go, both of you, with Our signs––We shall be with you, listen-ing.
verses.ar: قَالَ كَلَّا ۖ فَٱذْهَبَا بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَآ ۖ إِنَّا مَعَكُم مُّسْتَمِعُونَ

verses.en: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh and say, “We bring a message from the Lord of the Worlds:
verses.ar: فَأْتِيَا فِرْعَوْنَ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولُ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.en: let the Children of Israel leave with us.” ’
Pharaoh said, ‘Did we not bring you up as a child among us? Did you not stay with us for many years?
verses.ar: قَالَ أَلَمْ نُرَبِّكَ فِينَا وَلِيدًا وَلَبِثْتَ فِينَا مِنْ عُمُرِكَ سِنِينَ

verses.en: And then you committed that crime of yours: you were so ungrateful.’
verses.ar: وَفَعَلْتَ فَعْلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِى فَعَلْتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ

verses.en: Moses replied, ‘I was misguided when I did it
verses.ar: قَالَ فَعَلْتُهَآ إِذًا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

verses.en: and I fled from you in fear; later my Lord gave me wisdom and made me one of His messengers.
verses.ar: فَفَرَرْتُ مِنكُمْ لَمَّا خِفْتُكُمْ فَوَهَبَ لِى رَبِّى حُكْمًا وَجَعَلَنِى مِنَ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ

verses.en: And is this- that you have enslaved the Children of Israel- the favour with which you reproach me?’
verses.ar: وَتِلْكَ نِعْمَةٌ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَىَّ أَنْ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

verses.en: Pharaoh asked, ‘What is this “Lord of the Worlds”?’
Moses replied, ‘He is the Lord of the heavens and earth and everything between them. If you would only have faith!’
verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُم مُّوقِنِينَ

verses.en: Pharaoh said to those present, ‘Do you hear what he says?’
Moses said, ‘He is your Lord and the Lord of your forefathers.’
Pharaoh said, ‘This messenger who has been sent to you is truly possessed.’
verses.ar: قَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَكُمُ ٱلَّذِىٓ أُرْسِلَ إِلَيْكُمْ لَمَجْنُونٌ

verses.en: Moses continued, ‘Lord of the East and West and everything between them. If you would only use your reason!’
verses.ar: قَالَ رَبُّ ٱلْمَشْرِقِ وَٱلْمَغْرِبِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ

verses.en: But Pharaoh said [to him], ‘If you take any god other than me, I will throw you into prison,’
verses.ar: قَالَ لَئِنِ ٱتَّخَذْتَ إِلَـٰهًا غَيْرِى لَأَجْعَلَنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمَسْجُونِينَ

verses.en: and Moses asked, ‘Even if I show you something convincing?’
‘Show it then,’ said Pharaoh, ‘if you are telling the truth.’
verses.ar: قَالَ فَأْتِ بِهِۦٓ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

verses.en: So Moses threw down his staff and- lo and behold!- it became a snake for everyone to see.
verses.ar: فَأَلْقَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ ثُعْبَانٌ مُّبِينٌ

verses.en: Then he drew out his hand and- lo and behold!- it was white for the onlookers to see.
verses.ar: وَنَزَعَ يَدَهُۥ فَإِذَا هِىَ بَيْضَآءُ لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ

verses.en: Pharaoh said to the counsellors around him, ‘This man is a learned sorcerer!
verses.ar: قَالَ لِلْمَلَإِ حَوْلَهُۥٓ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَسَـٰحِرٌ عَلِيمٌ

verses.en: He means to use his sorcery to drive you out of your land! What do you suggest?’
verses.ar: يُرِيدُ أَن يُخْرِجَكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِۦ فَمَاذَا تَأْمُرُونَ

verses.en: They answered, ‘Delay him and his brother for a while, and send messengers to all the cities
verses.ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَرْجِهْ وَأَخَاهُ وَٱبْعَثْ فِى ٱلْمَدَآئِنِ حَـٰشِرِينَ

verses.en: to bring every accomplished sorcerer to you.’
The sorcerers were [to be] assembled at the appointed time on a certain day
and the people were asked, "Are you all coming?
We may follow the sorcerers if they win!"
verses.ar: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُوا۟ هُمُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ

verses.en: When the sorcerers came, they said to Pharaoh, ‘Shall we be rewarded if we win?’
verses.ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ قَالُوا۟ لِفِرْعَوْنَ أَئِنَّ لَنَا لَأَجْرًا إِن كُنَّا نَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبِينَ

verses.en: and he said, ‘Yes, and you will join my inner court.’
verses.ar: قَالَ نَعَمْ وَإِنَّكُمْ إِذًا لَّمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ

verses.en: Moses said to them, ‘Throw down whatever you will.’
verses.ar: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰٓ أَلْقُوا۟ مَآ أَنتُم مُّلْقُونَ

verses.en: They threw their ropes and staffs, saying, ‘By Pharaoh’s might, we shall be victorious.’
verses.ar: فَأَلْقَوْا۟ حِبَالَهُمْ وَعِصِيَّهُمْ وَقَالُوا۟ بِعِزَّةِ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّا لَنَحْنُ ٱلْغَـٰلِبُونَ

verses.en: But Moses threw his staff and- lo and behold!- it swallowed up their trickery
verses.ar: فَأَلْقَىٰ مُوسَىٰ عَصَاهُ فَإِذَا هِىَ تَلْقَفُ مَا يَأْفِكُونَ

verses.en: and the sorcerers fell down on their knees,
exclaiming, ‘We believe in the Lord of the Worlds,
the Lord of Moses and Aaron.’

Pharaoh said, ‘How dare you believe in him before I have given you permission? He must be the master who taught you sorcery! Soon you will see: I will cut off your alternate hands and feet and then crucify the lot of you!’
verses.ar: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ فَلَسَوْفَ تَعْلَمُونَ ۚ لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ

verses.en: ‘That will do us no harm,’ they said, ‘for we are sure to return to our Lord.
verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَا ضَيْرَ ۖ إِنَّآ إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا مُنقَلِبُونَ

verses.en: We hope that our Lord will forgive us our sins, as we were the first to believe.’
verses.ar: إِنَّا نَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لَنَا رَبُّنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَآ أَن كُنَّآ أَوَّلَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: Then We revealed Our will to Moses, ‘Leave with My servants by night, for you will be pursued!’
verses.ar: ۞ وَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِىٓ إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ

verses.en: Pharaoh sent messengers into the cities, proclaiming,
‘These people are a puny band––
they have enraged us-
and we are a large army, on the alert.’
So it was that We made them leave their gardens and their springs,
their treasures and their noble dwellings-
We gave [such] things [later]to the Children of Israel.
Pharaoh and his people pursued them at sunrise,
and as soon as the two sides came within sight of one another, Moses’ followers said, ‘We shall definitely be caught.’
verses.ar: فَلَمَّا تَرَٰٓءَا ٱلْجَمْعَانِ قَالَ أَصْحَـٰبُ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنَّا لَمُدْرَكُونَ

verses.en: Moses said, ‘No, my Lord is with me: He will guide me,’
verses.ar: قَالَ كَلَّآ ۖ إِنَّ مَعِىَ رَبِّى سَيَهْدِينِ

verses.en: and We revealed to Moses: ‘Strike the sea with your staff.’ It parted- each side like a mighty mountain-
verses.ar: فَأَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنِ ٱضْرِب بِّعَصَاكَ ٱلْبَحْرَ ۖ فَٱنفَلَقَ فَكَانَ كُلُّ فِرْقٍ كَٱلطَّوْدِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ

verses.en: and We brought the others to that place:
We saved Moses and all his companions,
and drowned the rest.
There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
Tell them the story of Abraham,
when he asked his father and his people, ‘What do you worship?’
verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لِأَبِيهِ وَقَوْمِهِۦ مَا تَعْبُدُونَ

verses.en: They said, ‘We worship idols, and are constantly in attendance on them.’
verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ نَعْبُدُ أَصْنَامًا فَنَظَلُّ لَهَا عَـٰكِفِينَ

verses.en: He asked, ‘Do they hear you when you call?
Do they help or harm you?’
They replied, ‘No, but this is what we saw our fathers doing.’
verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ وَجَدْنَآ ءَابَآءَنَا كَذَٰلِكَ يَفْعَلُونَ

verses.en: Abraham said, ‘Those idols you have worshipped,
you and your forefathers,
are my enemies; not so the Lord of the Worlds,
verses.ar: فَإِنَّهُمْ عَدُوٌّ لِّىٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.en: who created me. It is He who guides me;
He who gives me food and drink;
He who cures me when I am ill;
He who will make me die and then give me life again;
and He who will, I hope, forgive my faults on the Day of Judgement.
verses.ar: وَٱلَّذِىٓ أَطْمَعُ أَن يَغْفِرَ لِى خَطِيٓـَٔتِى يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ

verses.en: My Lord, grant me wisdom; join me with the righteous;
verses.ar: رَبِّ هَبْ لِى حُكْمًا وَأَلْحِقْنِى بِٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ

verses.en: give me a good name among later generations;
verses.ar: وَٱجْعَل لِّى لِسَانَ صِدْقٍ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرِينَ

verses.en: make me one of those given the Garden of Bliss-
forgive my father, for he is one of those who have gone astray-
verses.ar: وَٱغْفِرْ لِأَبِىٓ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ

verses.en: and do not disgrace me on the Day when all people are resurrected:
the Day when neither wealth nor children can help,
verses.ar: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ

verses.en: when the only one who will be saved is the one who comes before God with a heart devoted to Him.’
verses.ar: إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى ٱللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ

verses.en: When the Garden is brought near to the righteous
and the Fire is placed in full view of the misguided,
it will be said to them, ‘Where are those you worshipped
verses.ar: وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تَعْبُدُونَ

verses.en: beside God? Can they help you now, or even help themselves?’
verses.ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ هَلْ يَنصُرُونَكُمْ أَوْ يَنتَصِرُونَ

verses.en: and then they will all be hurled into Hell, together with those that misled them,
and all Iblis’s supporters.
There they will say to their gods, as they bicker among themselves,
‘We were clearly misguided
verses.ar: تَٱللَّهِ إِن كُنَّا لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ

verses.en: when we made you equal with the Lord of the Worlds.
It was the evildoers who led us astray,
and now we have no intercessor
and no true friend.
If only we could live our lives again, we would be true believers!’
verses.ar: فَلَوْ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةً فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
The people of Noah, too, called the messengers liars.
Their brother Noah said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ نُوحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

verses.en: I am a faithful messenger sent to you:
be mindful of God and obey me.
I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds:
verses.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.en: be mindful of God and obey me.’
They answered, ‘Why should we believe you when the worst sort of people follow you?’
He said, ‘What knowledge do I have of what they used to do?
verses.ar: قَالَ وَمَا عِلْمِى بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

verses.en: It is for my Lord alone to bring them to account- if only you could see-
verses.ar: إِنْ حِسَابُهُمْ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّى ۖ لَوْ تَشْعُرُونَ

verses.en: I will not drive believers away.
I am here only to give people a clear warning.’
So they said, ‘Noah, if you do not stop this, you will be stoned.’
verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰنُوحُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَرْجُومِينَ

verses.en: He said, ‘My Lord, my people have rejected me,
so make a firm judgement between me and them, and save me and my believing followers.’
verses.ar: فَٱفْتَحْ بَيْنِى وَبَيْنَهُمْ فَتْحًا وَنَجِّنِى وَمَن مَّعِىَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: So We saved him and his followers in the fully laden ship,
verses.ar: فَأَنجَيْنَـٰهُ وَمَن مَّعَهُۥ فِى ٱلْفُلْكِ ٱلْمَشْحُونِ

verses.en: and drowned the rest.
There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
The people of Ad, too, called the messengers liars.
Their brother Hud said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ هُودٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

verses.en: I am a faithful messenger sent to you:
be mindful of God and obey me.
I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.en: How can you be so vain that you set up monuments on every high place?
Do you build fortresses because you hope to be immortal?
Why do you act like tyrants whenever you attack someone?
Be mindful of God and obey me;
be mindful of Him who has provided you with everything you know-
He has given you livestock, sons,
gardens, springs-
for I truly fear that the torment of a grievous day will overtake you.’
verses.ar: إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

verses.en: They replied, ‘It makes no difference to us whether you warn us or not,
verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيْنَآ أَوَعَظْتَ أَمْ لَمْ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْوَٰعِظِينَ

verses.en: for we only do what our forefathers used to do:
we shall not be punished.’
They denounced him as a liar, and so We destroyed them. There truly is a sign in this, though most of them do not believe:
verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَهْلَكْنَـٰهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
The people of Thamud, too, called the messengers liars.
Their brother Salih said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ صَـٰلِحٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

verses.en: I am a faithful messenger to you:
be mindful of God and obey me.
I ask no reward from you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.en: [Do you think] you will be left secure for ever in what you have here-
gardens, springs,
fields, palm trees laden with fruit-
carving your fine houses from the mountains?
Be mindful of God and obey me:
do not obey those who are given to excess
and who spread corruption in the land instead of doing what is right.’
verses.ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُفْسِدُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا يُصْلِحُونَ

verses.en: They said, ‘You are bewitched!
You are nothing but a man like us. Show us a sign, if you are telling the truth.’
verses.ar: مَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا فَأْتِ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

verses.en: He said, ‘Here is a camel. She should have her turn to drink and so should you, each on a specified day,
verses.ar: قَالَ هَـٰذِهِۦ نَاقَةٌ لَّهَا شِرْبٌ وَلَكُمْ شِرْبُ يَوْمٍ مَّعْلُومٍ

verses.en: so do not harm her, or the punishment of a terrible day will befall you.’
verses.ar: وَلَا تَمَسُّوهَا بِسُوٓءٍ فَيَأْخُذَكُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

verses.en: But they hamstrung her. In the morning they had cause to regret it:
the punishment fell upon them. There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
verses.ar: فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
The people of Lot, too, called the messengers liars.
Their brother Lot said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ أَخُوهُمْ لُوطٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

verses.en: I am a faithful messenger to you:
be mindful of God and obey me.
I ask no reward from you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.en: Must you, unlike [other] people, lust after males
and abandon the wives that God has created for you? You are exceeding all bounds,’
verses.ar: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمْ رَبُّكُم مِّنْ أَزْوَٰجِكُم ۚ بَلْ أَنتُمْ قَوْمٌ عَادُونَ

verses.en: but they replied, ‘Lot! If you do not stop this, you will be driven away.’
verses.ar: قَالُوا۟ لَئِن لَّمْ تَنتَهِ يَـٰلُوطُ لَتَكُونَنَّ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْرَجِينَ

verses.en: So he said, ‘I loathe what you do:
Lord, save me and my family from what they are doing.’
We saved him and all his family,
except for an old woman who stayed behind,
then We destroyed the others,
and poured a rain of destruction down upon them. How dreadful that rain was for those who had been forewarned!
verses.ar: وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِم مَّطَرًا ۖ فَسَآءَ مَطَرُ ٱلْمُنذَرِينَ

verses.en: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
The forest-dwellers, too, called the messengers liars.
Shuayb said to them, ‘Will you not be mindful of God?
verses.ar: إِذْ قَالَ لَهُمْ شُعَيْبٌ أَلَا تَتَّقُونَ

verses.en: I am a faithful messenger to you:
be mindful of God and obey me.
I ask no reward of you, for my only reward is with the Lord of the Worlds.
verses.ar: وَمَآ أَسْـَٔلُكُمْ عَلَيْهِ مِنْ أَجْرٍ ۖ إِنْ أَجْرِىَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ

verses.en: Give full measure: do not sell others short.
verses.ar: ۞ أَوْفُوا۟ ٱلْكَيْلَ وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ مِنَ ٱلْمُخْسِرِينَ

verses.en: Weigh with correct scales:
do not deprive people of what is theirs. Do not spread corruption on earth.
verses.ar: وَلَا تَبْخَسُوا۟ ٱلنَّاسَ أَشْيَآءَهُمْ وَلَا تَعْثَوْا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مُفْسِدِينَ

verses.en: Be mindful of God who created you and former generations,’
but they replied, ‘You are bewitched!
You are nothing but a man like us. In fact we think you are a liar.
verses.ar: وَمَآ أَنتَ إِلَّا بَشَرٌ مِّثْلُنَا وَإِن نَّظُنُّكَ لَمِنَ ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ

verses.en: Make bits of the heavens fall down on us, if you are telling the truth.’
verses.ar: فَأَسْقِطْ عَلَيْنَا كِسَفًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ

verses.en: He said, ‘My Lord knows best what you do.’
They called him a liar, and so the torment of the Day of Shadow came upon them- it was the torment of a terrible day.
verses.ar: فَكَذَّبُوهُ فَأَخَذَهُمْ عَذَابُ يَوْمِ ٱلظُّلَّةِ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَذَابَ يَوْمٍ عَظِيمٍ

verses.en: There truly is a sign in this, though most of them will not believe:
verses.ar: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً ۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكْثَرُهُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: your Lord alone is the Almighty, the Merciful.
Truly, this Quran has been sent down by the Lord of the Worlds:
the Trustworthy Spirit brought it down
to your heart [Prophet], so that you could bring warning
in a clear Arabic tongue.
This was foretold in the scriptures of earlier religions.
Is it not proof enough for them that the learned men of the Children of Israel have recognized it?
verses.ar: أَوَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُمْ ءَايَةً أَن يَعْلَمَهُۥ عُلَمَـٰٓؤُا۟ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ

verses.en: If We had sent it down to someone who was not an Arab,
and he had recited it to them, they still would not have believed in it.
verses.ar: فَقَرَأَهُۥ عَلَيْهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ مُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: So We make it pass straight through the hearts of the guilty:
they will not believe in it until they see the grievous torment,
verses.ar: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰ يَرَوُا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ ٱلْأَلِيمَ

verses.en: which will suddenly hit them when they are not expecting it,
and then they will say, ‘Can we have more time?’
How can they ask that Our punishment be brought to them sooner?
Think, if we let them enjoy this life for some years
and then the promised torment came upon them,
what good would their past enjoyment be to them?
verses.ar: مَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يُمَتَّعُونَ

verses.en: Never have We destroyed a town without sending down messengers to warn it,
verses.ar: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا لَهَا مُنذِرُونَ

verses.en: as a reminder from Us: We are never unjust.
It was not the jinn who brought down this Quran:
it is neither in their interests nor in their power,
indeed they are prevented from overhearing it.
So [Prophet] do not invoke any gods beside God, or you will incur punishment.
verses.ar: فَلَا تَدْعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلْمُعَذَّبِينَ

verses.en: Warn your nearest kinsfolk
and lower your wing tenderly over the believers who follow you.
verses.ar: وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ

verses.en: If they disobey you, say, ‘I bear no responsibility for your actions.’
verses.ar: فَإِنْ عَصَوْكَ فَقُلْ إِنِّى بَرِىٓءٌ مِّمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ

verses.en: Put your trust in the Almighty, the Merciful,
who sees you when you stand up [for prayer]
and sees your movements among the worshippers:
He is the All Hearing, the All Knowing.
Shall I tell you who the jinn come down to?
verses.ar: هَلْ أُنَبِّئُكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَـٰطِينُ

verses.en: They come down to every lying sinner
who readily lends an ear to them, and most of them are liars:
only those who are lost in error follow the poets.
Do you not see how they rove aimlessly in every valley;
verses.ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ أَنَّهُمْ فِى كُلِّ وَادٍ يَهِيمُونَ

verses.en: how they say what they do not do?
Not so those [poets] who believe, do good deeds, remember God often, and defend themselves after they have been wronged. The evildoers will find out what they will return to.
verses.ar: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرًا وَٱنتَصَرُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا ظُلِمُوا۟ ۗ وَسَيَعْلَمُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَىَّ مُنقَلَبٍ يَنقَلِبُونَ
